heading: Paste to Markdown
subtitle: Convert copied text (from Word, Web, etc.) to Markdown instantly ⚡
toast_nothing_to_copy: There is no content to copy.
toast_vscode_detected: VS Code detected — pasting raw text!
tip_paste: 💡 Tip: Paste (Ctrl+V) text copied from Word, Excel, or the Web to convert it to Markdown.
tip_autoconvert: 💡 In the ⚙️ Settings, you can find 'Auto-convert to Markdown on Paste'. Turn it off to paste content as plain text without conversion.
mode_editable: Anyone with the link can edit
mode_editable_desc: Opening the link and saving updates this same link.
mode_readonly_desc: Content is frozen; editing creates a new link.
share_result_hint: Anyone with this link can open it. The key is in the link — share over a trusted channel.
toast_not_configured: Storage not configured — missing Firebase projectId.
toast_not_found: Shared doc not found (expired or wrong link).
toast_decrypt_failed: Could not decrypt — wrong key or altered data.
toast_loaded_editable: Loaded — you can edit and save to this link.
toast_loaded_readonly: Loaded (read-only). Editing will fork a new link.
toast_save_failed: Could not save. Please try again.
toast_copy_failed: Copy failed — select and copy manually
